mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_agent_memory(memory_code,namespace_code,agent_code,scope_type,scope_code,memory_level,content,tags_json, source_type,source_ref,confidence,importance,expires_at,created_by_key_id,idempotency_key,payload_fingerprint) VALUES(#{code},#{namespace},#{agent},#{scopeType},#{scopeCode},#{level},#{content},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON), #{sourceType},#{sourceRef},#{confidence},#{importance},#{expiresAt},#{keyId},#{idempotencyKey},#{payloadFingerprint}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT memory_code memoryCode,expires_at expiresAt,scope_type scopeType,scope_code scopeCode, memory_level memoryLevel,content,payload_fingerprint payloadFingerprint FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND agent_code=#{agent} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT memory_code memoryCode,namespace_code namespaceCode,agent_code agentCode,scope_type scopeType, scope_code scopeCode,memory_level memoryLevel,content,tags_json tags,source_type sourceType,source_ref sourceRef, confidence,importance,expires_at expiresAt,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime, (MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) * 10) + CASE WHEN #{query} != '' AND content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN #{query} != '' AND CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END + importance * confidence AS relevanceScore FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((scope_type='AGENT' AND agent_code=#{agent}) OR (scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_code=#{scopeCode})) AND (#{query} = '' OR MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 OR content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY relevanceScore DESC,importance DESC,updated_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT memory_code memoryCode,namespace_code namespaceCode,agent_code agentCode,scope_type scopeType, scope_code scopeCode,memory_level memoryLevel,content,tags_json tags,source_type sourceType,source_ref sourceRef, confidence,importance,expires_at expiresAt,status,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND memory_code=#{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM t_agent_memory_scope_access WHERE api_key_id=#{keyId} AND namespace_code=#{namespace} AND scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_code=#{scopeCode} AND status='ACTIVE' AND ((#{accessMode}='READ' AND can_read=1) OR (#{accessMode}='WRITE' AND can_write=1))

SELECT scope_type scopeType,scope_code scopeCode,can_read canRead,can_write canWrite, created_by_operator createdByOperator,created_time createdTime FROM t_agent_memory_scope_access WHERE api_key_id=#{keyId} AND namespace_code=#{namespace} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY scope_type,scope_code

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM t_principal_memory_scope_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND namespace_code=#{namespace} AND scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_code=#{scopeCode} AND status='ACTIVE' AND ((#{accessMode}='READ' AND can_read=1) OR (#{accessMode}='WRITE' AND can_write=1))

SELECT scope_type scopeType,scope_code scopeCode,can_read canRead,can_write canWrite, created_by_operator createdByOperator,created_time createdTime FROM t_principal_memory_scope_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND namespace_code=#{namespace} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY scope_type,scope_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_principal_memory_scope_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND NOT (scope_type='AGENT' AND scope_code <=> #{agentCode})
mapper.select: SELECT memory_code memoryCode,namespace_code namespaceCode,agent_code agentCode,scope_type scopeType,scope_code scopeCode,status FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND memory_code=#{code} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_agent_memory SET status=#{status},updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND memory_code=#{code} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND memory_code=#{code}
DELETE FROM t_agent_memory WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (memory_level='L0' OR expires_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 DAY))
